articles.title: Anthropic's Dario Amodei responds: doesn't oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
articles.titleEn: Anthropic's Dario Amodei responds: doesn't oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
articles.titleKo: Anthropic의 Dario Amodei는 다음과 같이 응답함 · 개방형 모델에 반대하지는 않지만 중국 AI를 두려워함
articles.summary:
His response came after Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang took to X ( his first post on the platform) to share an open letter on Friday in which Nvidia and a long list of other AI companies including Hugging Face, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral, and Nvidia urged policymakers not to impose broad “premature restrictions” on open-weight AI models.
“I think this idea is actually close to a consensus: I have been heartened both that the Trump administration has moved in this direction in recent months, and by recent industry proposals that would apply such testing to the most capable models regardless of their country of origin or whether they are open or closed (while exempting less capable models, such as those from startups and academia, entirely),” Amodei wrote.
And, in his view, open-weight models are more dangerous in those scenarios because it’s difficult to apply guardrails to them or monitor their usage.
summaryLinesEn: His response came after Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang took to X ( his first post on the platform) to share an open letter on Friday in which Nvidia and a long list of other AI companies including Hugging Face, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral, and Nvidia urged policymakers not to impose broad “premature restrictions” on open-weight AI models.

“I think this idea is actually close to a consensus: I have been heartened both that the Trump administration has moved in this direction in recent months, and by recent industry proposals that would apply such testing to the most capable models regardless of their country of origin or whether they are open or closed (while exempting less capable models, such as those from startups and academia, entirely),” Amodei wrote.
And, in his view, open-weight models are more dangerous in those scenarios because it’s difficult to apply guardrails to them or monitor their usage.
summaryLinesKo: 그의 반응은 Nvidia 창립자이자 CEO인 Jensen Huang이 금요일에 Nvidia와 Hugging Face, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral 및 Nvidia를 포함한 다른 AI 회사들의 긴 목록이 정책 입안자들에게 개방형 AI 모델에 광범위한 "성급한 제한"을 부과하지 말 것을 촉구하는 공개 서한을 공유하기 위해 X(플랫폼에 대한 첫 번째 게시물)를 방문한 후에 나왔음
Amodei는 "나는 이 아이디어가 실제로 합의에 가깝다고 생각함 · 나는 트럼프 행정부가 최근 몇 달 동안 이런 방향으로 움직였다는 사실과 출신 국가나 개방 여부에 상관없이 가장 유능한 모델에 이러한 테스트를 적용하겠다는 최근 업계 제안에 고무됐다"고 말했음
그리고 그의 견해로는 개방형 모델은 가드레일을 적용하거나 사용량을 모니터링하기 어렵기 때문에 이러한 시나리오에서 더 위험함

articles.title: How would AI data centers in space even work? A former NASA robotics chief explains
articles.titleEn: How would AI data centers in space even work? A former NASA robotics chief explains
articles.titleKo: 우주에 있는 AI 데이터 센터는 어떻게 작동할까요? 전 NASA 로봇 공학 책임자가 설명함
articles.summary:
However, if data centers make it to the moon, you can expect a 1.6-second lag back and forth with transmissions, Ambrose added.
At NASA, for instance, "every piece of flight hardware that I've ever been responsible for that's been launched into space has had to go through vibration tests.
Currently, it costs SpaceX about $2,900 per kilogram to launch a payload, and that number needs to drop below $500 to make space data centers economically viable.
summaryLinesEn: However, if data centers make it to the moon, you can expect a 1.6-second lag back and forth with transmissions, Ambrose added.
At NASA, for instance, "every piece of flight hardware that I've ever been responsible for that's been launched into space has had to go through vibration tests.
Currently, it costs SpaceX about $2,900 per kilogram to launch a payload, and that number needs to drop below $500 to make space data centers economically viable.
summaryLinesKo: 그러나 데이터 센터가 달에 도착하면 전송 시 1.6초의 지연이 발생할 수 있다고 Ambrose는 덧붙였음
예를 들어 NASA에서는 "우주로 발사되는 모든 비행 하드웨어는 진동 테스트를 거쳐야 했음
현재 SpaceX는 페이로드를 발사하는 데 킬로그램당 약 2,900달러의 비용이 들며, 우주 데이터 센터를 경제적으로 실행 가능하게 만들려면 그 숫자를 500달러 미만으로 줄여야 함

articles.title: Shared Claude chats were reportedly showing up in search engines
articles.titleEn: Shared Claude chats were reportedly showing up in search engines
articles.titleKo: 공유된 Claude 채팅이 검색 엔진에 표시되는 것으로 알려졌음
articles.summary:
Users on Reddit found thousands of shared chats with Anthropic's AI chatbot through a simple Google search ( site:claude.ai/share ).
A Google search for site:claude.ai SEARCH TERM turns up many of these artifacts on Claude.ai.
The "Share with link" feature apparently lacked a noindex tag, which tells search engines not to include pages in their results.

Google에서 site:claude·ai 검색어를 검색하면 Claude·ai에서 이러한 유물이 많이 발견됨
링크로 공유" 기능에는 검색 엔진이 결과에 페이지를 포함하지 않도록 지시하는 noindex 태그가 없는 것 같음

articles.title: METR introduces a new metric to calculate exactly when AI agents become more expensive than humans
articles.titleEn: METR introduces a new metric to calculate exactly when AI agents become more expensive than humans
articles.titleKo: METR은 AI 에이전트가 인간보다 비용이 더 많이 드는 시기를 정확하게 계산하는 새로운 측정항목을 도입함
articles.summary:
According to Anthropic, Opus 5 wastes less effort on dead ends, checks its own work more reliably, and achieves similar performance with an average of 26 percent fewer compute steps.
Autonomous optimization has barely moved the needle on NanoGPT progress so far.
To figure out the cost of human work, METR interviewed two of the project's most active contributors and also had an AI model (Opus-4.6) estimate the effort behind each improvement.

Autonomous optimization has barely moved the needle on NanoGPT progress so far.
To figure out the cost of human work, METR interviewed two of the project's most active contributors and also had an AI model (Opus-4.6) estimate the effort behind each improvement.
summaryLinesKo: Anthropic에 따르면 Opus 5는 막다른 골목에서 더 적은 노력을 낭비하고 자체 작업을 더 안정적으로 확인하며 평균 26% 더 적은 컴퓨팅 단계로 비슷한 성능을 달성함
자율 최적화는 지금까지 NanoGPT 진행에 거의 영향을 미치지 않았음
인적 작업 비용을 파악하기 위해 METR은 프로젝트의 가장 활동적인 기여자 두 명을 인터뷰하고 AI 모델(Opus-4.6)을 통해 각 개선에 따른 노력을 추정했음

articles.title: Google's AI search is rapidly becoming the default, new data shows
articles.titleEn: Google's AI search is rapidly becoming the default, new data shows
articles.titleKo: 구글의 AI 검색이 빠르게 기본이 되고 있다는 새로운 데이터가 나타났음
articles.summary:
During the same period, AI Mode visits rose from 126 million in June 2025 to 279 million by May 2026.
In just a year’s time, Google’s AI-generated answers in search, known as AI Overviews , have gone from appearing in 15% of searches to 43%, according to a new report, driving a shift in how web users consume information online.
This change has not been welcomed by publishers, who are losing out on referral traffic due to the rise of AI citations that don’t lead to clicks.

This change has not been welcomed by publishers, who are losing out on referral traffic due to the rise of AI citations that don’t lead to clicks.
summaryLinesKo: 같은 기간 AI 모드 방문 횟수는 2025년 6월 1억 2,600만 명에서 2026년 5월 2억 7,900만 명으로 증가했음
새로운 보고서에 따르면 불과 1년 만에 AI 개요로 알려진 Google의 AI 생성 답변이 검색의 15%에서 43%로 감소하여 웹 사용자가 온라인에서 정보를 소비하는 방식에 변화를 가져왔음
이러한 변화는 클릭으로 이어지지 않는 AI 인용의 증가로 인해 추천 트래픽을 잃고 있는 출판사에서는 환영받지 못함

articles.title: Are brain waves the next unlock for physical AI?
articles.titleEn: Are brain waves the next unlock for physical AI?
articles.titleKo: 물리적 AI의 다음 잠금 해제는 뇌파입니까
articles.summary:
Encord’s work with Zander is currently a trial run; Encord says the goal is to build an initial brain wave-tagged data set, run it through customer robotics models, and evaluate whether it actually improves performance before deciding whether to scale it up.
But “20 times more” is still real money, and that’s the catch: scraping text off the internet, the way LLM makers built their models by pulling from Stack Overflow and the rest of the web, cost frontier labs next to nothing.
Velmurugan estimates this kind of dense annotation is worth 100 times as much as “junky ego data” for training specific tasks, and it only costs 20 times more to produce, which is a good trade, on paper.

It added that regulators should recognize open models as "defensive assets, not liabilities," saying that blanket restrictions on open frontier AI systems "weaken defensive capacity and risk concentrating power" to a few closed providers.

articles.title: Private Claude Chats Exposed in Google and Bing Search Results

articles.titleKo: Google 및 Bing 검색 결과에 노출된 비공개 Claude 채팅
articles.summary:
Bing, which still shows “about 612 results” if you search “site: claude.ai/share ” at the time of this writing, says in its technical documentation that developers can block the search engine’s web crawlers using robots.txt—but that web developers should also include a “noindex” tag on individual pages as well.
Basically, Anthropic instructs web crawlers, like those used by search engines like Google and Bing, not to index chats a user decides to share with other people.
Some of the chats that showed up in search results flagged in the Reddit post were deleted by the time WIRED viewed them, and results no longer show up in Google when you search the “share” query that still worked on Bing.

articles.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3 open weights and infrastructure after shaking up the frontier model race
articles.titleEn: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3 open weights and infrastructure after shaking up the frontier model race
articles.titleKo: Moonshot AI, 프론티어 모델 경쟁을 뒤흔든 Kimi K3 오픈 웨이트 및 인프라 출시
articles.summary:
Since its initial announcement in mid-July 2026, Kimi K3 has caused a stir by scoring close to Western frontier models such as Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on popular benchmarks, but at a slightly lower cost and now with open weights.
Chinese AI company Moonshot AI has released the model weights and technical report for Kimi K3.
Along with the model weights on Hugging Face , the company is open-sourcing parts of its infrastructure, including high-performance attention kernels, an MoE communication library, and tools for running AI agents at scale.

articles.title: Closing the data loop in AI-driven drug discovery
articles.titleEn: Closing the data loop in AI-driven drug discovery
articles.titleKo: AI 기반 신약 발견의 데이터 루프 종료
articles.summary:
Today, bringing a new drug to market takes an average of 10-15 years and costs anywhere from $1 billion to $2.5 billion , with failure rates upward of 90%.
Belcher has seen a shift from empirical screening to predictive design: Instead of physically screening libraries, drug companies are now using AI to design drug candidates from scratch and predict how they will interact with disease targets before committing anything to research and development (R&D).
“The main cost in drug discovery is still the clinical phase, so trying to reduce risk and increase your success rates there is obviously hugely beneficial,” says Paul Belcher, director of protein research strategy at global life sciences company Cytiva.
summaryLinesEn: Today, bringing a new drug to market takes an average of 10-15 years and costs anywhere from $1 billion to $2.5 billion , with failure rates upward of 90%.

Belcher has seen a shift from empirical screening to predictive design: Instead of physically screening libraries, drug companies are now using AI to design drug candidates from scratch and predict how they will interact with disease targets before committing anything to research and development (R&D).

“The main cost in drug discovery is still the clinical phase, so trying to reduce risk and increase your success rates there is obviously hugely beneficial,” says Paul Belcher, director of protein research strategy at global life sciences company Cytiva.
summaryLinesKo: 오늘날 신약을 시장에 출시하는 데는 평균 10~15년이 걸리고 비용은 10억~25억 달러에 달하며 실패율은 90% 이상임
Belcher는 경험적 스크리닝에서 예측 설계로 전환했음 · 제약 회사는 이제 라이브러리를 물리적으로 스크리닝하는 대신 AI를 사용하여 약물 후보를 처음부터 설계하고 연구 개발(R&D)에 착수하기 전에 질병 표적과 상호 작용하는 방식을 예측하고 있음
글로벌 생명과학 기업인 Cytiva의 단백질 연구 전략 이사인 Paul Belcher는 “약물 발견의 주요 비용은 여전히 임상 단계이므로 위험을 줄이고 성공률을 높이려는 노력은 분명히 큰 이점이 있습니다.”라고 말함

articles.titleEn: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
articles.titleKo: Nvidia, Microsoft, OpenAI, Google 또는 Anthropic 없이 개방형 AI 보안 동맹 출시
articles.summary:
Nvidia on Monday said it is joining forces with Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM, and other tech companies to build and share open-source AI security tools.
That company, Hugging Face, said it was forced to use a Chinese open-weight model to defend itself due to the strict safety guardrails limiting the usefulness of top US models.
Nvidia and its partners argue that securing AI requires access to both closed and open models, stressing that defenders need the tools to counter emerging threats.

articles.summary:
On Sunday, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella doubled down on the shocking warning he issued earlier this month to businesses that use AI, taking it a step further this time.
When Zakaria asked Nadella to explain what constitutes a company sharing too much with an AI model provider, Nadella said businesses need to be wary of everything they hand over, from their data to their prompts.

articles.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
articles.titleEn: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
articles.titleKo: Monday·com은 해고의 원인으로 AI를 비난한 최신 기술 회사임 · 다른 20개 회사는 다음과 같음
articles.summary:
Monday.com, the Tel Aviv-based work management software company known for its colorful, customizable project-tracking boards, this week became the latest tech company to cite AI as a factor in job cuts.
Meta, for instance, earlier this year moved roughly 7,000 employees into new AI-focused roles even as it laid off 8,000 others, and IBM says it’s tripling entry-level hiring for AI and hybrid-cloud roles alongside recent cuts.
On Wednesday, the company said in an SEC filing that it will lay off about 20% of its workforce, or just over 600 employees, as part of a “restructuring plan” tied to its “ongoing transformation of its product, marketing, and go-to-market strategy” in support of “a leaner, more focused operating model” as it continues investing in its “AI-driven growth strategy.”

articles.titleKo: 수백 명이 ChatGPT에 독극물 및 생물 무기 조리법을 요청했고 일부는 단계별 고등학교 수준 가이드를 받았음
articles.summary:
In summer 2025, OpenAI internally flagged GPT-5 as high-risk because the model could help users with limited education create biological hazards.
Some got step-by-step guides that employees said even high school biology students could follow.
Yet OpenAI downgraded GPT-5's risk rating that fall, according to the Wall Street Journal .
summaryLinesEn: In summer 2025, OpenAI internally flagged GPT-5 as high-risk because the model could help users with limited education create biological hazards.
Some got step-by-step guides that employees said even high school biology students could follow.
Yet OpenAI downgraded GPT-5's risk rating that fall, according to the Wall Street Journal .
summaryLinesKo: 2025년 여름, OpenAI는 내부적으로 GPT-5를 고위험으로 표시했음 · 이 모델은 제한된 교육을 받은 사용자가 생물학적 위험을 생성하는 데 도움이 될 수 있기 때문임
일부 직원들은 고등학교 생물 학생들도 따라할 수 있다고 말한 단계별 가이드를 받았음

articles.title: Anthropic's Opus 5 blows past Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on the benchmark designed to measure real intelligence
articles.titleEn: Anthropic's Opus 5 blows past Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on the benchmark designed to measure real intelligence
articles.titleKo: Anthropic의 Opus 5는 실제 지능을 측정하기 위해 설계된 벤치마크에서 Fable 5 및 GPT-5.6 Sol을 능가함
articles.summary:
Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 scored 30.2 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, nearly four times the previous record of 7.8 percent set by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol (Max).
Annotators could have labeled reasoning traces, useful actions, failed attempts, and recovery steps from similar puzzles.
The ARC Prize team attributes the lead to genuinely stronger logical reasoning that enables more autonomous exploration and planning in unfamiliar environments.
summaryLinesEn: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 scored 30.2 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, nearly four times the previous record of 7.8 percent set by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol (Max).
Annotators could have labeled reasoning traces, useful actions, failed attempts, and recovery steps from similar puzzles.
The ARC Prize team attributes the lead to genuinely stronger logical reasoning that enables more autonomous exploration and planning in unfamiliar environments.
summaryLinesKo: Anthropic의 Claude Opus 5는 ARC-AGI-3 벤치마크에서 30.2%를 기록했는데, 이는 OpenAI의 GPT-5.6 Sol(Max)이 세운 이전 기록인 7.8%의 거의 4배에 해당함
주석자는 유사한 퍼즐의 추론 추적, 유용한 작업, 실패한 시도 및 복구 단계에 레이블을 지정할 수 있음
ARC Prize 팀은 익숙하지 않은 환경에서 더 자율적인 탐색과 계획을 가능하게 하는 진정으로 더 강력한 논리적 추론이 이러한 결과의 원인이라고 생각함

articles.title: Can Apple make smart glasses that aren’t a constant privacy threat?
articles.titleEn: Can Apple make smart glasses that aren’t a constant privacy threat?
articles.titleKo: Apple이 지속적으로 개인 정보를 위협하지 않는 스마트 안경을 만들 수 있습니까
articles.summary:
Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.
As Apple prepares to launch its first smart glasses, the company is also wrestling with how to address consumer privacy concerns, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman .
Gurman reports that Apple has pushed back the launch target from early 2027, with the glasses now set for unveiling at the Worldwide Developers Conference in June 2027 and actually becoming available by the end of the year.

articles.title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here's how to fix it.
articles.titleEn: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here's how to fix it.
articles.titleKo: 하나의 떨어진 전력선으로 인해 점점 커지는 AI 데이터 센터 문제가 드러났음 · 문제를 해결하는 방법은 다음과 같음
articles.summary:
When the power line went down this week, it triggered data centers to switch to backup power, and about 3.1 gigawatts of load vanished in about 30 seconds, according to PJM data .
But this one took more than 10 minutes because more than 3 gigawatts of data centers stopped drawing power nearly simultaneously.
ON.Energy is currently installing a total of 3 gigawatts worth of its systems at four different data center campuses, de Azevedo said.
summaryLinesEn: When the power line went down this week, it triggered data centers to switch to backup power, and about 3.1 gigawatts of load vanished in about 30 seconds, according to PJM data .

ON.Energy is currently installing a total of 3 gigawatts worth of its systems at four different data center campuses, de Azevedo said.
summaryLinesKo: PJM 데이터에 따르면 이번 주 전력선이 끊어지면서 데이터 센터가 백업 전원으로 전환되었고 약 30초 만에 약 3.1기가와트의 부하가 사라졌음
하지만 3기가와트 이상의 데이터 센터가 거의 동시에 전력 공급을 중단했기 때문에 이 작업에는 10분 이상이 걸렸음
ON·Energy는 현재 4개의 서로 다른 데이터 센터 캠퍼스에 총 3기가와트 상당의 시스템을 설치하고 있다고 de Azevedo는 말했음

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 costs well below Fable 5 while matching or beating it across most benchmarks
articles.titleEn: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 costs well below Fable 5 while matching or beating it across most benchmarks
articles.titleKo: Anthropic의 Claude Opus 5 가격은 Fable 5보다 훨씬 낮지만 대부분의 벤치마크에서 일치하거나 능가함
articles.summary:
Lower reasoning tiers deliver better value and coding results The average Intelligence Index task costs $2.03 with Opus 5, less than Claude Fable 5 with fallback at $2.75.
Cache writes cost $6.25 per million tokens with a five-minute lifetime, while cache hits run just $0.50 per million tokens.
Because Opus 5 tends to respond more frequently even when uncertain, its hallucination rate climbs to 50 percent, raising questions about reliability in high-stakes applications.
summaryLinesEn: Lower reasoning tiers deliver better value and coding results The average Intelligence Index task costs $2.03 with Opus 5, less than Claude Fable 5 with fallback at $2.75.
Cache writes cost $6.25 per million tokens with a five-minute lifetime, while cache hits run just $0.50 per million tokens.
Because Opus 5 tends to respond more frequently even when uncertain, its hallucination rate climbs to 50 percent, raising questions about reliability in high-stakes applications.
summaryLinesKo: 낮은 추론 계층은 더 나은 가치와 코딩 결과를 제공함 · Opus 5의 평균 Intelligence Index 작업 비용은 2.03달러로 대체 비용이 포함된 Claude Fable 5의 2.75달러보다 저렴함
캐시 쓰기 비용은 5분 동안 토큰 백만 개당 6.25달러인 반면, 캐시 적중은 토큰 백만 개당 0.50달러에 불과함
Opus 5는 불확실한 경우에도 더 자주 반응하는 경향이 있기 때문에 환각 비율이 50%까지 올라가 고위험 애플리케이션의 신뢰성에 대한 의문이 제기됨

articles.titleEn: I tried out OpenAI's new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else

That said, if you’re a ChatGPT power user, have $230 to spare, and like vintage-looking hardware with clicky buttons, Micro probably isn’t the worst purchase you could make — it might even brighten your day a little.

You’ll need to memorize that, along with memorizing which specific projects are coded to each key.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 delivers near-Fable 5 performance at half the token price
articles.titleEn: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 delivers near-Fable 5 performance at half the token price
articles.titleKo: Anthropic의 Claude Opus 5는 토큰 가격의 절반으로 Fable 5에 가까운 성능을 제공함
articles.summary:
On Frontier-Bench v0.1, the model hits 43.3 percent on agentic terminal coding, beating Fable 5 (33.7 percent), GPT-5.6 Sol (34.4 percent), and its predecessor Opus 4.8 (21.1 percent) by wide margins.
Anthropic says Opus 5 can check and improve its own work through iteration, and build its own tools through code when it needs them.
Opus 4.7 ended up costing 30 to 40 percent more per task than Opus 4.6 , even though both models had the same base rates.

articles.summary:
In a general prompt injection test by security firm Gray Swan , the success rate after 15 attempts dropped from 5.5 percent (Opus 4.8) to 2.0 percent.
Without them, Opus 5 sits at 3.7 percent, and Sonnet 5 actually does better at 0.93 percent.
Prompt injection , where an attacker slips past an AI model's instructions through manipulated inputs like hidden text on a webpage, fails against Opus 5 in almost every case.

articles.summary:
Additionally, Meta says “you only have to set up tasks with Meta AI once, then you can leave Meta AI to handle them,” allowing it to give you calendar briefings without re-prompting, generate meal plans on a weekly basis, or provide updates on product restocks.
The update will allow Meta AI to tap into your calendar to help you plan events and generate daily briefings, as well as perform in-depth research that you can steer as it progresses.

articles.titleKo: 리드 호프만(Reid Hoffman)과 마크 핀커스(Mark Pincus)가 공동 설립한 새로운 AI 연구소 프렌티스(Prentis), 1억 달러 모금 협상 중
articles.summary:
Hoffman, the LinkedIn co-founder and Greylock partner, said last month that he was stepping down from Microsoft’s board after nearly a decade to go “founder mode” on Manas AI, an AI drug-discovery startup he’s also backing; he was an early OpenAI investor and co-founded Inflection AI with Mustafa Suleyman before Microsoft absorbed most of that team in 2024.
Other businesses launched and operated by Titan include AI-powered virtual care provider Tala Health, which raised a $100 million seed round last year, and Forta Health, an autism care startup that raised $55 million led by Insight Partners in 2024.
Prentis will ostensibly develop agents tailored to these customers’ needs, such as handling insurance claims and automating customs duty refund exceptions without needing a human to hunt down paperwork.

articles.title: Some Kids Will Never Think AI Is Cool
articles.titleEn: Some Kids Will Never Think AI Is Cool
articles.titleKo: 어떤 아이들은 AI가 멋지다고 결코 생각하지 않을 것임
articles.summary:
Yes, many of them still use the tech for school assignments and companionship, but according to market research firm YPulse, 37 percent of teens aged 13 to 17 cringe when they see AI content like music and videos, and more than half worry about misinformation and deepfakes.
A recent Pew Research report found that while many teens think AI will be good for them personally, over a fourth of their cohort believe AI will have a negative impact on society in the next 20 years, citing job loss, the decline of critical thinking skills, and environmental impacts as concerns.

articles.summary:
For that, he said, AI tools can speed up the process and allow him to focus on discovering vulnerabilities.
“This is where the whole offensive versus defensive and guardrails part comes in, because ‘fix this code’ as a prompt is both an essential mechanism for defense but also a roadmap for finding critical vulnerabilities in the code base,” said Anley.
But these limits are now hindering the work of legitimate network defenders, as well as that of offensive cybersecurity researchers.

articles.title: AI Act
articles.titleEn: AI Act
articles.summary:
Together, these measures guarantee safety, fundamental rights and human-centric AI, and strengthen uptake, investment and innovation in AI across the EU.
While most AI systems pose limited to no risk and can contribute to solving many societal challenges, certain AI systems create risks that we must address to avoid undesirable outcomes.
So, it may become difficult to assess whether someone has been unfairly disadvantaged, such as in a hiring decision or in an application for a public benefit scheme.

articles.title: Open co-design networking underpins AMD’s Helios strategy at scale
articles.titleEn: Open co-design networking underpins AMD’s Helios strategy at scale
articles.titleKo: 개방형 공동 설계 네트워킹은 AMD의 Helios 전략을 대규모로 뒷받침함
articles.summary:
Open co-design networking facilitates shared AI infrastructure That co-design networking extends deep into the fabric itself, where AMD and Meta jointly built the scale-up interconnect that binds Helios’ GPUs into a single resource pool.
The work reflects a broader industry pivot, as Ethernet has now surpassed InfiniBand in AI back-end network deployments.
“The role of the network is only increasing because if you have to deliver these systems at scale with performance, with high availability, and this type of token consumption of 158X in two years, the network is foundational to deliver a balanced approach,” Jiandani said.

이더넷이 이제 AI 백엔드 네트워크 배포에서 InfiniBand를 능가함에 따라 이 작업은 더 광범위한 산업 전환을 반영함

articles.title: Schneider Electric, AMD Blueprint for AI Factory Deployments
articles.titleEn: Schneider Electric, AMD Blueprint for AI Factory Deployments
articles.titleKo: Schneider Electric, AI 공장 배포를 위한 AMD 청사진
articles.summary:
AI Infrastructure Deployment as an Engineering Challenge The release of the design blueprint comes as AI infrastructure deployment is shifting from securing compute capacity to integrating complex systems across an entire operation spanning power, cooling, networking and operations.
The design is built around AMD’s Helios rackscale platform and can support AI racks with power densities of up to 246kW and modular, multi-cluster environments with up to 10.4MW of IT capacity.
The design is intended to support modular scaling, with AI clusters of up to 10.4MW of IT capacity for greenfield deployments and infrastructure capable of supporting high-density AI workloads in existing facilities.
summaryLinesEn: AI Infrastructure Deployment as an Engineering Challenge The release of the design blueprint comes as AI infrastructure deployment is shifting from securing compute capacity to integrating complex systems across an entire operation spanning power, cooling, networking and operations.
The design is built around AMD’s Helios rackscale platform and can support AI racks with power densities of up to 246kW and modular, multi-cluster environments with up to 10.4MW of IT capacity.

The design is intended to support modular scaling, with AI clusters of up to 10.4MW of IT capacity for greenfield deployments and infrastructure capable of supporting high-density AI workloads in existing facilities.
summaryLinesKo: 엔지니어링 과제로서의 AI 인프라 배포 이번 설계 청사진의 출시는 AI 인프라 배포가 컴퓨팅 용량 확보에서 전력, 냉각, 네트워킹 및 운영을 포괄하는 전체 운영에 걸쳐 복잡한 시스템 통합으로 전환되고 있는 가운데 나온 것임
이 설계는 AMD의 Helios 랙스케일 플랫폼을 기반으로 구축되었으며 최대 246kW의 전력 밀도를 갖춘 AI 랙과 최대 10.4MW의 IT 용량을 갖춘 모듈형, 멀티 클러스터 환경을 지원할 수 있음
이 설계는 그린필드 배포를 위한 최대 10.4MW의 IT 용량을 갖춘 AI 클러스터와 기존 시설의 고밀도 AI 워크로드를 지원할 수 있는 인프라를 통해 모듈식 확장을 지원하기 위한 것임

articles.title: Anthropic updates Claude voice mode with more capable models
articles.titleEn: Anthropic updates Claude voice mode with more capable models
articles.titleKo: Anthropic은 더 유능한 모델로 Claude 음성 모드를 업데이트함
articles.summary:
Anthropic said that the new voice mode can help users with longer conversations, including providing feedback on their communication style, talking through a pitch to a client, and brainstorming product market research.
Earlier this year, Anthropic added multilingual support to Claude’s voice mode in beta.
Weeks after OpenAI rolled out a new family of conversational models and updated ChatGPT’s voice mode , rival Anthropic is making its move to make Claude more voice-friendly with a new update.

올해 초 Anthropic은 베타 버전에서 Claude의 음성 모드에 다국어 지원을 추가했음
OpenAI가 새로운 대화 모델 제품군을 출시하고 ChatGPT의 음성 모드를 업데이트한 지 몇 주 후, 경쟁사인 Anthropic은 새로운 업데이트를 통해 Claude를 더욱 음성 친화적으로 만들기 위해 노력하고 있음

articles.summary:
The weak spot was ChatGPT's agent builder, the feature used to spin up AI assistants that can work across email, chat, calendars, and other business apps.
Connecting AI agents to outside services explodes the risk radius OpenAI admits GPT-5.6 occasionally deletes files – but it's an 'honest mistake' OpenAI's Atlas browser doesn't make it to its first birthday "This isn't a forged request, it's a forged insider," Michael Bargury, co-founder and CTO of Zenity, told The Register .

articles.summary:
It's hard to say because the commercial makes very few references to any of Meta's AI features.
But the centerpiece of his company's new "optimistic" ad campaign, at least for now, is a one-minute commercial for Meta's AI efforts that... features very little AI.
According to a Meta spokesperson, the ad is the start of a broader effort from the company to present an alternative view to "AI doomers and those who have sketched out a dystopian vision" for the future.

articles.title: OpenAI's agent breached Hugging Face before an AI defender caught it: What users should do next
articles.titleEn: OpenAI's agent breached Hugging Face before an AI defender caught it: What users should do next
articles.titleKo: OpenAI의 에이전트는 AI 방어자가 포착하기 전에 Hugging Face를 침해했음 · 사용자가 다음에 해야 할 일
articles.summary:
The organization hasn't found any evidence of tampering with public and user-facing models, Spaces, or its software supply chain -- at least, at this stage.
On July 21, OpenAI stated that the rogue agent was one of theirs , and broke out of a sandboxed testing environment to access the internet and pull answers to an evaluation from Hugging Face.
In a security advisory published July 16, Hugging Face said that it detected unauthorized access to a limited set of internal datasets and to several credentials used by the platform's services.

In a security advisory published July 16, Hugging Face said that it detected unauthorized access to a limited set of internal datasets and to several credentials used by the platform's services.
summaryLinesKo: 조직은 적어도 현 단계에서는 공개 및 사용자 대면 모델, Spaces 또는 소프트웨어 공급망을 조작했다는 증거를 찾지 못했음
7월 21일, OpenAI는 악성 에이전트가 그들의 에이전트 중 하나였으며 샌드박스 테스트 환경에서 벗어나 인터넷에 접속하고 Hugging Face에서 평가에 대한 답변을 가져왔다고 밝혔음
Hugging Face는 7월 16일 발표된 보안 권고에서 제한된 내부 데이터 세트와 플랫폼 서비스에서 사용되는 여러 자격 증명에 대한 무단 액세스를 감지했다고 밝혔음

articles.title: AI image fraud will cost $40 billion next year - can these international standards help?
articles.titleEn: AI image fraud will cost $40 billion next year - can these international standards help?
articles.titleKo: AI 이미지 사기 비용은 내년에 400억 달러에 달할 것임 · 이러한 국제 표준이 도움이 될까요
articles.summary:
Also: OpenAI's attack agent did exactly what it was told - just more relentlessly than expected Efforts to guard against fraud in multimedia began in earnest in 2018, when the JPEG committee of IEC and ISO first addressed a growing concern about inauthentic content.
There's a huge financial cost as well: Generative AI could enable fraud losses to reach $40 billion in the US by 2027, up from $12.3 billion in 2023, according to estimates from Deloitte's Center for Financial Services.
International standards bodies are stepping up efforts to help provide the tools that end users and companies need to distinguish real images, videos, and other content from deepfakes and AI-generated slop.

There's a huge financial cost as well: Generative AI could enable fraud losses to reach $40 billion in the US by 2027, up from $12.3 billion in 2023, according to estimates from Deloitte's Center for Financial Services.

International standards bodies are stepping up efforts to help provide the tools that end users and companies need to distinguish real images, videos, and other content from deepfakes and AI-generated slop.
summaryLinesKo: 또한: OpenAI의 공격 에이전트는 예상보다 더 가차 없이 지시된 대로 수행했음 · 멀티미디어 사기를 방지하기 위한 노력은 2018년 IEC 및 ISO의 JPEG 위원회가 처음으로 허위 콘텐츠에 대한 우려를 제기하면서 본격적으로 시작되었음
엄청난 재정적 비용도 있음 · Deloitte 금융 서비스 센터의 추정에 따르면 Generative AI로 인해 미국에서 사기 손실이 2023년 123억 달러에서 2027년까지 400억 달러에 이를 수 있음
국제 표준 기관에서는 최종 사용자와 기업이 실제 이미지, 비디오 및 기타 콘텐츠를 딥페이크 및 AI 생성 슬롭과 구별하는 데 필요한 도구를 제공하기 위한 노력을 강화하고 있음

articles.title: One tampered ChatGPT link could spawn a rogue AI agent that took orders from an attacker every five minutes
articles.titleEn: One tampered ChatGPT link could spawn a rogue AI agent that took orders from an attacker every five minutes
articles.titleKo: 변조된 ChatGPT 링크 하나가 5분마다 공격자의 명령을 받는 악성 AI 에이전트를 생성할 수 있음
articles.summary:
A single tampered ChatGPT link could spin up an AI agent that quietly checked the attacker's inbox for new orders every five minutes.
The Agent Builder, introduced in 2025, is available at chatgpt.com/agents/studio/new and accepts two URL parameters. template_name selects a starting template such as "chief-of-staff," while initial_assistant_prompt supplies the instructions.
All they needed was a chatgpt.com link with an attached prompt that looked harmless at first glance.
summaryLinesEn: A single tampered ChatGPT link could spin up an AI agent that quietly checked the attacker's inbox for new orders every five minutes.

The Agent Builder, introduced in 2025, is available at chatgpt.com/agents/studio/new and accepts two URL parameters. template_name selects a starting template such as "chief-of-staff," while initial_assistant_prompt supplies the instructions.
All they needed was a chatgpt.com link with an attached prompt that looked harmless at first glance.
summaryLinesKo: 변조된 ChatGPT 링크 하나만으로 공격자의 받은 편지함에서 5분마다 새로운 주문이 있는지 조용히 확인하는 AI 에이전트가 가동될 수 있음
2025년에 도입된 Agent Builder는 chatgpt·com/agents/studio/new에서 사용할 수 있으며 두 개의 URL 매개변수를 허용함 · template_name은 "Chief of Staff"와 같은 시작 템플릿을 선택하고,initial_assistant_prompt는 지침을 제공함
그들에게 필요한 것은 언뜻 보기에 무해해 보이는 프롬프트가 첨부된 chatgpt·com 링크뿐이었음

articles.title: ChatGPT will give you worse health advice if you don't pay
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT will give you worse health advice if you don't pay
articles.titleKo: ChatGPT는 비용을 지불하지 않으면 더 나쁜 건강 조언을 제공함
articles.summary:
Despite more than 300 million people asking ChatGPT health questions each week, risks remain significant: AI chatbots have been shown to give incorrect medical findings with high confidence rather than admitting uncertainty.
OpenAI's early tests also found that more than 70 percent of participants asked health questions outside the dedicated Health section because switching to it was too cumbersome.
Free users receive lower-quality health advice powered by GPT-5.5 Instant, while paying subscribers get access to the stronger GPT-5.6 Sol model.
summaryLinesEn: Despite more than 300 million people asking ChatGPT health questions each week, risks remain significant: AI chatbots have been shown to give incorrect medical findings with high confidence rather than admitting uncertainty.
OpenAI's early tests also found that more than 70 percent of participants asked health questions outside the dedicated Health section because switching to it was too cumbersome.
Free users receive lower-quality health advice powered by GPT-5.5 Instant, while paying subscribers get access to the stronger GPT-5.6 Sol model.
summaryLinesKo: 매주 3억 명이 넘는 사람들이 ChatGPT 건강 관련 질문을 하고 있음에도 불구하고 위험은 여전히 심각함 · AI 챗봇은 불확실성을 인정하기보다는 높은 확신을 가지고 잘못된 의학적 결과를 제공하는 것으로 나타났음
OpenAI의 초기 테스트에서는 또한 참가자의 70% 이상이 전용 건강 섹션으로 전환하는 것이 너무 번거롭기 때문에 전용 건강 섹션 외부에서 건강 관련 질문을 하는 것으로 나타났음
무료 사용자는 GPT-5.5 Instant가 제공하는 낮은 품질의 건강 조언을 받고, 유료 가입자는 더 강력한 GPT-5.6 Sol 모델에 액세스할 수 있음

articles.title: AMD takes on Nvidia with its Helios AI rack-scale system
articles.titleEn: AMD takes on Nvidia with its Helios AI rack-scale system
articles.titleKo: AMD는 Helios AI 랙 스케일 시스템으로 Nvidia를 상대함
articles.summary:
“We’re now expecting that by 2030, the AI accelerator market is going to reach about $1.4 trillion,” Su said.
AMD also introduced Thursday its Venice-X CPU, which is designed for data centers and to handle high-computing workloads.
Chipmaker AMD is taking aim at competitor Nvidia with its latest hardware release: a rack-scale system designed to power computing needs of the world’s largest AI labs.

articles.title: Runway launches AI model router as generative media gets crowded
articles.titleEn: Runway launches AI model router as generative media gets crowded
articles.titleKo: 생성 미디어가 혼잡해짐에 따라 Runway, AI 모델 라우터 출시
articles.summary:
“Most developers are not spending the time to really understand the capabilities of each of these models and where they excel or differ based on various types of outputs across video, image, and audio,” Maggio said.
On Thursday, the startup launched Runway Media Router through Runway Dev , its developer platform, released earlier this month, that provides API access to a growing roster of third-party image, video, and audio models alongside Runway’s own.
The Media Router is a tool that automatically selects the best image, video, or audio generation model for a request based on whether a developer prioritizes quality, speed, or cost.

articles.titleEn: OpenAI cyber models broke out of training environment to hack Hugging Face
articles.titleKo: OpenAI 사이버 모델이 Hugging Face를 해킹하기 위해 훈련 환경을 이탈했음
articles.summary:
Walter Isaacson, advisory partner at the investment banking firm Perella Weinberg, said Wednesday that he thinks the Hugging Face incident is "really frightening," even though he considers himself an AI optimist.
OpenAI introduced its own cyber offering in May, followed by GPT-5.6 Sol in June, which it described as the "strongest cybersecurity model yet."
OpenAI said Tuesday that AI is accelerating the discovery and exploitation of vulnerabilities, which means model security and safety need to keep up.

articles.title: After shocking quarter, IBM insists that AI isn't killing the mainframe
articles.titleEn: After shocking quarter, IBM insists that AI isn't killing the mainframe
articles.titleKo: 충격적인 분기 이후 IBM은 AI가 메인프레임을 죽이지 않는다고 주장
articles.summary:
While the 115-year-old company still generates boatloads of cash — $17.2 billion in revenue, $9.9 billion in gross profit, nearly 58% margins, and $2.2 billion in net earnings for the quarter — its results fell well short of Wall Street’s expectations.
That’s a cascading problem, because as CFO Jim Kavanaugh explained on the quarterly call with investors, IBM earns $3 in software revenue for every $1 of mainframe hardware it sells.
On Wednesday, IBM also lowered its full-year growth forecasts, meaning this horrible quarter would impact the rest of the year.

이는 계단식 문제임 · 왜냐하면 CFO Jim Kavanaugh가 투자자와의 분기별 통화에서 설명했듯이 IBM은 판매하는 메인프레임 하드웨어 1달러당 소프트웨어 수익으로 3달러를 벌기 때문임

articles.title: Google justifies its massive AI spending with a booming cloud business
articles.titleEn: Google justifies its massive AI spending with a booming cloud business
articles.titleKo: Google은 급성장하는 클라우드 비즈니스로 대규모 AI 지출을 정당화함
articles.summary:
The search giant saw Google Cloud revenue spike 82% from where it was this time last year, climbing to $24.8 billion.
The company’s profit hit $112.1 billion, which is a massive jump from this time last year, when the company reported $28.1 billion in profit, the company’s earnings report shows.
The takeaway: Google’s cloud business — driven largely by enterprise AI adoption — is booming.

Eischen said this rate limit is designed to support “normal usage” while protecting the detection system from being misused.

articles.title: Utility companies promise to spare us from AI’s energy bill
articles.titleEn: Utility companies promise to spare us from AI’s energy bill
articles.titleKo: 유틸리티 회사는 AI의 에너지 비용으로부터 우리를 보호하겠다고 약속함
articles.summary:
In the face of backlash to concerns the AI boom will increase consumer electricity bills, the largest utility companies and data center developers in the US are now promising to do something about it.
The rate protection pledge was introduced in March, and includes several vague commitments for AI providers to front the costs of new infrastructure required to train and run generative AI models.
Some data center projects have been downsized or blocked in response to the backlash, and the largest US electrical grid operator PJM is now expected to add $6.3 billion in additional costs for consumers across 13 states due to data center demand.

Some data center projects have been downsized or blocked in response to the backlash, and the largest US electrical grid operator PJM is now expected to add $6.3 billion in additional costs for consumers across 13 states due to data center demand.
summaryLinesKo: AI 붐으로 인해 소비자 전기 요금이 인상될 것이라는 우려에 반발하여 미국 최대 유틸리티 회사와 데이터 센터 개발자들은 이에 대해 조치를 취하겠다고 약속하고 있음
요금 보호 서약은 3월에 도입되었으며 AI 제공업체가 생성 AI 모델을 훈련하고 실행하는 데 필요한 새로운 인프라 비용을 앞당기겠다는 몇 가지 모호한 약속을 포함하고 있음
일부 데이터 센터 프로젝트는 반발에 대응하여 규모가 축소되거나 차단되었으며, 미국 최대 전력망 운영업체인 PJM은 이제 데이터 센터 수요로 인해 13개 주의 소비자에게 63억 달러의 추가 비용을 추가할 것으로 예상됨

articles.title: Hyundai claims humanoid robot plan is not part of talks with striking workers
articles.titleEn: Hyundai claims humanoid robot plan is not part of talks with striking workers
articles.titleKo: 현대차, 휴머노이드 로봇 계획은 파업 노동자들과의 협상의 일부가 아니라고 주장
articles.summary:
However, The Wall Street Journal described the Hyundai Motor union as making “unprecedented demands seeking to enshrine job protections in the era of robots and AI,” and characterized certain compensation demands as hedging against potential reductions in work hours caused by AI adoption and robotic automation.
“In this time of major transition, whether these developments become a disaster that forces insecurity and sacrifice onto workers or an opportunity to improve quality of life will largely depend on the government’s choices and policy direction,” the organization said in a statement reported by The Korea Times .
The yellow envelope law may also “slow the transition to robot labor” because it recognizes management decisions that significantly impact working conditions as being subject to collective bargaining and action, The Korea Times reported.
summaryLinesEn: However, The Wall Street Journal described the Hyundai Motor union as making “unprecedented demands seeking to enshrine job protections in the era of robots and AI,” and characterized certain compensation demands as hedging against potential reductions in work hours caused by AI adoption and robotic automation.

“In this time of major transition, whether these developments become a disaster that forces insecurity and sacrifice onto workers or an opportunity to improve quality of life will largely depend on the government’s choices and policy direction,” the organization said in a statement reported by The Korea Times .

The yellow envelope law may also “slow the transition to robot labor” because it recognizes management decisions that significantly impact working conditions as being subject to collective bargaining and action, The Korea Times reported.
summaryLinesKo: 그러나 월스트리트저널은 현대차 노조가 “로봇과 AI 시대에 일자리 보호를 명목으로 하는 전례 없는 요구를 하고 있다”고 설명하며, 일부 보상 요구는 AI 도입과 로봇 자동화로 인한 노동시간 단축 가능성에 대비한 것이라고 규정했음
“대전환의 시기에 이러한 사태가 노동자들에게 불안과 희생을 강요하는 재앙이 될지, 아니면 삶의 질을 향상시킬 수 있는 기회가 될지는 정부의 선택과 정책 방향에 크게 좌우될 것”이라고 코리아타임스가 보도한 성명에서 밝혔음
노란 봉투법은 노동 조건에 큰 영향을 미치는 경영 결정을 단체 교섭과 행동의 대상으로 인정하기 때문에 “로봇 노동으로의 전환을 늦출 수 있다”고 코리아 타임즈가 보도했음

articles.summary:
Since then, TSMC has announced a total of $200 billion in commitments to the country, including last week's unveiling of a $100 billion investment into advanced semiconductor manufacturing and packaging facilities in the U.S.
"Broadly, we estimate TSMC's US chips to cost 20-50% more than those produced in Taiwan, depending on subsidy timing, tax credit recognition and other cost fluctuations," Phelix Lee, senior equity analyst at Morningstar, told CNBC.
Pressure from President Donald Trump to shift manufacturing from overseas to the U.S. is hitting margins at TSMC.

articles.titleKo: 재료과학 혁신으로 차세대 AI 발전
articles.summary:
Every increase in computing performance increases the physical demands placed on the systems that make and run AI.
For example, as data centers shift to higher-voltage architectures and greater power density, many of the materials challenges we face closely mirror those of electric vehicles.
Increasing computing density is transforming data center design, driving the need for more sophisticated thermal management, higher-voltage power architectures, increased data storage, and faster, more reliable data transmission.
summaryLinesEn: Every increase in computing performance increases the physical demands placed on the systems that make and run AI.
For example, as data centers shift to higher-voltage architectures and greater power density, many of the materials challenges we face closely mirror those of electric vehicles.

Increasing computing density is transforming data center design, driving the need for more sophisticated thermal management, higher-voltage power architectures, increased data storage, and faster, more reliable data transmission.
summaryLinesKo: 컴퓨팅 성능이 향상될 때마다 AI를 만들고 실행하는 시스템에 대한 물리적 요구도 증가함
예를 들어, 데이터 센터가 더 높은 전압 아키텍처와 더 높은 전력 밀도로 전환함에 따라 우리가 직면한 많은 재료 문제는 전기 자동차의 문제와 밀접하게 유사함
컴퓨팅 밀도가 높아지면서 데이터 센터 설계가 변화하고 있으며, 더욱 정교한 열 관리, 고전압 전력 아키텍처, 데이터 스토리지 증가, 더욱 빠르고 안정적인 데이터 전송에 대한 필요성이 커지고 있음

articles.title: AI and the rise of the universal entertainment app
articles.titleEn: AI and the rise of the universal entertainment app
articles.titleKo: AI와 유니버설 엔터테인먼트 앱의 부상
articles.summary:
The market for entertainment apps is reaching maturity, so growth has slowed, pushing companies to compete on time spent and revenue-per-user instead of new sign-ups.
Meanwhile, YouTube, originally the home to longer-form creator content, moved into short-form content to compete with TikTok, while also adding dedicated space for podcasts , gaming content, music, movies and TV, sports and news, shopping, and more.
After adding podcasts, the company added support for video podcasts, social features like Q&As and commenting, stories , and messaging , as well as different types of content like fitness classes , audiobooks , narrated magazines , and even physical book sales .
summaryLinesEn: The market for entertainment apps is reaching maturity, so growth has slowed, pushing companies to compete on time spent and revenue-per-user instead of new sign-ups.

Meanwhile, YouTube, originally the home to longer-form creator content, moved into short-form content to compete with TikTok, while also adding dedicated space for podcasts , gaming content, music, movies and TV, sports and news, shopping, and more.

After adding podcasts, the company added support for video podcasts, social features like Q&As and commenting, stories , and messaging , as well as different types of content like fitness classes , audiobooks , narrated magazines , and even physical book sales .
summaryLinesKo: 엔터테인먼트 앱 시장이 성숙기에 접어들면서 성장이 둔화되면서 기업은 신규 가입 대신 소요 시간과 사용자당 수익을 두고 경쟁하게 되었음
한편 원래 긴 형식의 제작자 콘텐츠의 본거지였던 YouTube는 TikTok과 경쟁하기 위해 짧은 형식의 콘텐츠로 이동하는 동시에 팟캐스트, 게임 콘텐츠, 음악, 영화 및 TV, 스포츠 및 뉴스, 쇼핑 등을 위한 전용 공간도 추가했음
팟캐스트를 추가한 후 회사는 비디오 팟캐스트, Q&A, 댓글, 스토리, 메시지 등의 소셜 기능은 물론 피트니스 수업, 오디오북, 내레이션 잡지, 실제 도서 판매 등 다양한 유형의 콘텐츠에 대한 지원을 추가했음

articles.title: Jack Dorsey is taking on Slack with Buzz, a group chat platform for teams and their AI agents
articles.titleEn: Jack Dorsey is taking on Slack with Buzz, a group chat platform for teams and their AI agents
articles.summary:
It looks a lot like Slack, but with native AI agents and the ability to manage GitHub projects all from the same window.
Since the platform is open source, developers can make their own Buzz instance feel more customized to the needs and workflows of their specific team.
a new groupchat platform for teams of people and agents of all sizes, built to reduce our dependency on slack and github. model-agnostic, decentralized, self-sovereign, and open source. 🐝 https://t.co/8IaMVeTQNo As startups increasingly rely on AI agents to get work done, it can be challenging for employees to collaborate on various tasks across different platforms.

articles.title: Microsoft and Mistral expand strategic partnership to give enterprises and regulated industries frontier AI they can control - Source
articles.titleEn: Microsoft and Mistral expand strategic partnership to give enterprises and regulated industries frontier AI they can control - Source
articles.titleKo: Microsoft와 Mistral은 전략적 파트너십을 확장하여 기업 및 규제 산업에 제어 가능한 AI를 제공함 · - Source
articles.summary:
Mistral is adding its GPU capacity, drawing on thousands of the latest NVIDIA Vera Rubin GPUs to increase AI compute availability for customers and provide a shared platform for training, inference and large-scale deployment.
Microsoft will leverage Mistral’s expanded Europe-based GPU infrastructure to increase capacity for AI development and to support the delivery of MSFT’s cloud and AI services.
Consistent with Microsoft’s flexible approach to global infrastructure, which combines its own datacenters, leased facilities and strategic collaborations with third-party providers, it expands Microsoft’s capacity footprint in Europe and supports the European Digital Commitments announced in 2025.

Consistent with Microsoft’s flexible approach to global infrastructure, which combines its own datacenters, leased facilities and strategic collaborations with third-party providers, it expands Microsoft’s capacity footprint in Europe and supports the European Digital Commitments announced in 2025.

articles.title: Why Zillow's AI ROI numbers actually hold up | VentureBeat
articles.titleEn: Why Zillow's AI ROI numbers actually hold up | VentureBeat
articles.titleKo: Zillow의 AI ROI 수치가 실제로 유지되는 이유 | 벤처비트
articles.summary:
Roberts said Zillow's ability to credibly attribute a 40% increase in shipped code to AI adoption rests on a DORA metrics baseline the team put in place years earlier, not on the AI rollout itself.
"Claude is also very slow because the first part of assembling that context actually takes forever," Jain said.
Zillow chose to own that layer itself rather than depend on a single external chat interface, a decision Roberts said the team reached quickly once it looked at the shape of a real transaction rather than a single conversation.

"Claude is also very slow because the first part of assembling that context actually takes forever," Jain said.

Zillow chose to own that layer itself rather than depend on a single external chat interface, a decision Roberts said the team reached quickly once it looked at the shape of a real transaction rather than a single conversation.
summaryLinesKo: Roberts는 배송된 코드의 40% 증가를 AI 채택으로 확실하게 귀속시키는 Zillow의 능력은 AI 롤아웃 자체가 아니라 팀이 몇 년 전에 설정한 DORA 측정 기준에 달려 있다고 말했음
Claude는 또한 해당 컨텍스트를 조립하는 첫 번째 부분이 실제로 시간이 오래 걸리기 때문에 매우 느립니다."라고 Jain은 말했음
Zillow는 단일 외부 채팅 인터페이스에 의존하기보다는 해당 레이어 자체를 소유하기로 결정했으며, Roberts는 팀이 단일 대화가 아닌 실제 거래의 형태를 살펴본 후 신속하게 결정을 내렸다고 말했음

articles.title: AMD launches Helios, its first rack AI system to rival Nvidia, adding Microsoft as newest buyer
articles.titleEn: AMD launches Helios, its first rack AI system to rival Nvidia, adding Microsoft as newest buyer
articles.titleKo: AMD는 Nvidia와 경쟁할 첫 번째 랙 AI 시스템인 Helios를 출시하고 Microsoft를 최신 구매자로 추가했음
articles.summary:
In February, Meta announced it'll use up to 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs over time, starting with 1 gigawatt deployed on Helios racks later this year.
Like its peers, Microsoft needs as much compute as possible, especially as it ramps up its own model development and allocates more computing capacity to research and development.
"We're very focused on providing the best total cost of ownership, the lowest cost per token, all in," data center head Forrest Norrod told CNBC about AMD's first-generation system.

articles.summary:

“AI can be used to identify security vulnerabilities and exploit them with ease, so we need to prepare our defences accordingly,” he said.

articles.summary:
Only five months ago, in February, Databricks closed a $5 billion Series L raise at a $134 billion valuation .
In fact, Databricks has been on a year-and-a-half fundraising tear as it successfully transitioned its image into an AI provider and not just a yesteryear SaaS sensation.
Not surprisingly, in the blog post revealing the results , Databricks shared that “open models, and GLM 5.2 in particular, are now able to handle even the highest level of task difficulty” in coding, and at a total lower cost than proprietary models from Anthropic and OpenAI.

articles.title: The agent security gap: 54% of enterprises have already had an AI agent incident, and most still let agents share credentials
articles.titleEn: The agent security gap: 54% of enterprises have already had an AI agent incident, and most still let agents share credentials
articles.titleKo: 에이전트 보안 격차: 기업의 54%가 이미 AI 에이전트 사고를 겪었으며 대부분 여전히 에이전트가 자격 증명을 공유하도록 허용함
articles.summary:
Nearly half (48%) say some agents have scoped identities but many still share credentials, and another 32% say agents mostly run on shared API keys or borrowed human and service-account credentials.
When agents share credentials, a single compromised or over-permissioned agent carries a wide blast radius — and only three in ten enterprises (30%) isolate their highest-risk agents in sandboxes to bound that radius.
More than half have already had a confirmed agent security incident or a near-miss; only about a third give every agent its own scoped identity, and most agents still share credentials; and only three in ten isolate their highest-risk agents.

articles.title: The AI compute gap: Enterprises are buying infrastructure faster than they can measure what it costs
articles.titleEn: The AI compute gap: Enterprises are buying infrastructure faster than they can measure what it costs
articles.titleKo: AI 컴퓨팅 격차: 기업은 비용을 측정할 수 있는 것보다 더 빠르게 인프라를 구매하고 있음
articles.summary:
Finding 3: The next dollar goes to infrastructure they don’t yet run We asked where enterprises planned to evaluate AI infrastructure over the next 12 months.
Across 107 enterprises, AI infrastructure spending is accelerating well ahead of the ability to see or steer its economics.
Buying decisions turn on integration and total cost of ownership rather than headline token price — which is fortunate, because most enterprises cannot yet see their unit economics clearly: GPUs sit at half utilization or less, and fewer than half rigorously track what their compute actually costs.

articles.summary:
Alao countered that total consumption is climbing even faster as enterprises move from relatively simple chatbots to agents that reason through problems, call tools, search internal systems and take multiple steps before returning an answer.

Apple actually briefly switched the features on early for some Chinese users back in March, months ahead of getting the green light, and a feedback form aimed at Chinese users appeared on Apple's site late last year as the company inched closer to approval. iPhone shipments in China climbed 24.4 percent year-over-year in the second quarter, making Apple the fastest-growing smartphone brand in a market that otherwise kept shrinking.

articles.title: At last, a good reason to buy an AI PC: Reining in runaway token bills
articles.titleEn: At last, a good reason to buy an AI PC: Reining in runaway token bills
articles.titleKo: 마침내 AI PC를 구입해야 할 좋은 이유: 폭주하는 토큰 청구서 억제
articles.summary:
“Enterprises are becoming increasingly concerned about the economic sustainability of cloud-centric AI strategies as token consumption and associated usage costs continue to rise, driving greater interest in a hybrid strategy, by identifying workloads that can be processed more efficiently at the edge or on the device itself.”
The analyst therefore offered two numerical predictions: By 2029, 30 percent of enterprises will be using AI PCs to reduce their cloud AI token costs; By 2030, 70 percent of the corporate PC installed base will be capable of running some local GenAI workloads.
“On -device AI has yet to achieve mainstream adoption and remains largely confined to developer and enthusiast use cases,” he added.

summaryLinesKo: “토큰 소비 및 관련 사용 비용이 계속 증가함에 따라 기업은 클라우드 중심 AI 전략의 경제적 지속 가능성에 대해 점점 더 우려하고 있으며, 에지 또는 장치 자체에서 보다 효율적으로 처리할 수 있는 워크로드를 식별함으로써 하이브리드 전략에 대한 관심이 높아지고 있음

articles.title: Introducing Claude for Teachers
articles.titleEn: Introducing Claude for Teachers
articles.titleKo: 교사를 위한 Claude 소개
articles.summary:
This is the aim of Claude for Teachers: support the craft behind great teaching and protect what teachers value most—time with their students.
Connected to evidence-based curricula and the K-12 ecosystem Claude for Teachers connects to Learning Commons , giving Claude access to academic standards across all 50 states—and beneath each standard, the smaller learning competencies it's built from and the order students typically learn them.
Early evidence suggests that while the impact of AI tools for students is mixed and depends on the implementation, AI tools for teachers can strengthen instructional practice and improve student outcomes.
summaryLinesEn: This is the aim of Claude for Teachers: support the craft behind great teaching and protect what teachers value most—time with their students.

Connected to evidence-based curricula and the K-12 ecosystem Claude for Teachers connects to Learning Commons , giving Claude access to academic standards across all 50 states—and beneath each standard, the smaller learning competencies it's built from and the order students typically learn them.

Early evidence suggests that while the impact of AI tools for students is mixed and depends on the implementation, AI tools for teachers can strengthen instructional practice and improve student outcomes.
summaryLinesKo: 이것이 Claude for Teachers의 목표임 · 훌륭한 교육을 뒷받침하는 기술을 지원하고 교사가 가장 중요하게 생각하는 것, 즉 학생들과 함께하는 시간을 보호하는 것임
증거 기반 커리큘럼 및 K-12 생태계에 연결된 Claude for Teachers는 Learning Commons에 연결되어 Claude가 50개 주 전체의 학업 표준에 액세스할 수 있게 하며, 각 표준 아래에는 작은 학습 역량과 학생들이 일반적으로 학습하는 순서가 표시됨
초기 증거에 따르면 학생을 위한 AI 도구의 영향은 혼합되어 구현에 따라 다르지만 교사를 위한 AI 도구는 교육 실습을 강화하고 학생 성과를 향상시킬 수 있음

articles.title: What is sovereign AI — and why it will decide the winners and losers of the AI race
articles.titleEn: What is sovereign AI — and why it will decide the winners and losers of the AI race
articles.titleKo: 주권적 AI란 무엇이며, 이것이 AI 경주의 승자와 패자를 결정하는 이유
articles.summary:
Start with Stargate — a $500 billion U.S. commitment to own the global AI supply chain, announced January 2025 by OpenAI, SoftBank, Oracle and MGX, with $100 billion to deploy immediately.
Saudi Arabia’s HUMAIN — launched May 2025 under the Public Investment Fund and now with a minority stake from Aramco — is building the full AI stack: compute, models, cloud, applications.
Gartner’s November 2025 survey of 241 Western European chief information officers found 61% will shift toward local cloud providers specifically because of geopolitics — not performance, not cost.

articles.title: Saline Township to vote on 12-year tax break for Oracle's $43B data center project

articles.titleKo: Saline Township, Oracle의 430억 달러 규모 데이터 센터 프로젝트에 대한 12년 세금 감면에 대해 투표
articles.summary:
"It doesn't seem logical that this billion-dollar project, multi-billion dollar project now is going to get a break and the regular people surrounding this project that are already going to have to deal with pollution, rising power costs… we get no break," said Haushalter.
(WXYZ) — Saline Township officials are set to vote Wednesday evening on whether Oracle should receive a 12-year tax abatement for a data center project now estimated to cost more than $43 billion.
Fellow Saline Township resident Jordan Kleinsmith said he is also holding out hope that the data center won't be completed.

articles.title: Optical Interconnects Become Critical to AI Factory Expansion; CPO/NPO Market Expected to Exceed US$39 Billion by 2030, Says TrendForce
articles.titleEn: Optical Interconnects Become Critical to AI Factory Expansion; CPO/NPO Market Expected to Exceed US$39 Billion by 2030, Says TrendForce
articles.titleKo: 광학 상호 연결은 AI 공장 확장에 매우 중요함 · TrendForce에서는 CPO/NPO 시장이 2030년까지 390억 달러를 넘어설 것으로 예상함
articles.summary:
Meanwhile, the pluggable optical transceiver market is expected to remain sizeable, maintaining a market value of nearly $26 billion in 2030.
TrendForce forecasts that the CPO/NPO market will surpass $39 billion by 2030, with growth accelerating sharply between 2028 and 2029 as scale-up architectures begin incorporating optical interconnect technologies.
Consequently, TrendForce predicts that the markets for co-packaged optics (CPO) and near-packaged optics (NPO) will expand significantly, from around US$100 million in 2025 to over $39 billion by 2030.

"For a single 23-year-old with equity worth $20 million, it makes sense to work in the office for 100 hours a week," said Bloom.
Jain said that as Glean grew more rapidly in recent years, it has since moved into a larger office space and dedicated Thursday as its work-from-home day.
Arvind Jain, founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI for productivity, said he "was not eager" to bring his team members back to the office because finding an office is a hassle, but everyone wanted to be in person and return to their original mode of working when the company first started right before the pandemic in 2019.

articles.title: Anthropic Walks Back Policy That Could Have ‘Sabotaged’ AI Researchers Using Claude
articles.titleEn: Anthropic Walks Back Policy That Could Have ‘Sabotaged’ AI Researchers Using Claude
articles.titleKo: Claude를 사용하여 AI 연구원을 '파괴'시킬 수 있는 Anthropic Walk Back 정책
articles.summary:
Claude’s coding agent has become a favored tool among developers, including those working on open-source AI research projects, and researchers tell WIRED that the company’s latest policy could have led to a troubling future in which only a handful of leading AI labs could perform advanced AI research.
Anthropic argued that it would be “good for the world to have the option to slow or temporarily pause frontier AI development to enable societal structures and alignment research to keep up.”
Anthropic said it implemented the measures because Claude has become increasingly effective at accelerating AI research.

articles.title: Apple AFM 3 breaks on-device AI memory limits
articles.titleEn: Apple AFM 3 breaks on-device AI memory limits
articles.titleKo: Apple AFM 3, 기기 내 AI 메모리 한계 깨뜨려
articles.summary:
The DRAM wall for on-device agents just moved.
Rather than running a fixed model size for every request, AFM 3 Core Advanced adjusts how many parameters it activates based on what the task requires — 1 billion for simpler operations, up to 4 billion for harder ones, all drawn from the 20-billion-parameter pool in flash.
Credit: Image generated by VentureBeat using FLUX-2-Pro On-device AI models have stayed small because the entire weight set has to live in DRAM, capping practical parameter counts well below what server-side deployments use.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs: Big 4 AI Capex to Hit $5.3 Trillion by 2030
articles.titleEn: Goldman Sachs: Big 4 AI Capex to Hit $5.3 Trillion by 2030
articles.titleKo: Goldman Sachs: Big 4 AI Capex, 2030년까지 5조 3천억 달러 달성
articles.summary:
According to Reuters on Wednesday (local time), Goldman Sachs raised its combined capital expenditure (CAPEX) forecast for the four major hyperscalers—Meta Platforms, Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet—to $5.3 trillion (about 8,000 trillion won) for fiscal years 2025 to 2030 in a report that day.
Alphabet, Google's parent company, recently launched a rights offering worth $85 billion (about 130 trillion won), illustrating the reality that such investment demand is difficult to cover through internal cash and bond issuance alone.
It added, "As semiconductor manufacturers prioritize data center demand from large corporations, demand for relatively lower-margin electronic device products has been pushed to the back burner."

It added, "As semiconductor manufacturers prioritize data center demand from large corporations, demand for relatively lower-margin electronic device products has been pushed to the back burner."

구글의 모회사인 알파벳은 최근 850억 달러(약 130조원) 규모의 유상증자에 나섰는데, 이는 이러한 투자 수요를 내부현금과 채권발행만으로는 감당하기 어려운 현실을 보여준음

articles.titleKo: Microsoft, Meta 및 Google은 AI 지출에 수십억 달러를 추가로 발표했음 · 오직 Google만이 투자자들에게 성과가 있다고 확신했음 · | 행운
articles.summary:
Over at Meta Platforms, which also announced results on Wednesday, CEO Mark Zuckerberg told investors the company plans to increase its capex spending to $125 billion to $145 billion, up from a previous range of $115 billion to $135 billion.
The sequential increase includes roughly $5 billion from higher component pricing, as well as the impact from finance leases,” said Hood during her prepared remarks.
Alphabet , Meta Platforms, and Microsoft just broke the news to investors that they’ll be spending billions more on the AI race.
